raw: {"verdict": "warn", "note": "Training on TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes shard 0, which is the fixed evaluation shard (EVAL_SHARD=0), so val_bpb would be computed on data the model has trained on and would no longer reflect real generalization."}

parsed.note: Training on TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes shard 0, which is the fixed evaluation shard (EVAL_SHARD=0), so val_bpb would be computed on data the model has trained on and would no longer reflect real generalization.
